blocks.prompt: 5 If the numbers \(\frac{1}{k}, \frac{1}{2k + 1}\) and \(\frac{1}{4k - 1}\) are in harmonic sequence, find \(k\).
blocks.explanation:
Teen numbers H.P. mein hain, iska seedha matlab hai ke un ke reciprocals A.P. mein hain.
Reciprocals bahut saaf hain: \(k\), \(2k + 1\), \(4k - 1\).
Plan: A.P. ki pehchaan "darmiyani term ka double = dono kinaron ka jama" lagao aur \(k\) ki simple equation hal karo.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{1}{k}, \frac{1}{2k + 1}, \frac{1}{4k - 1}\) H.P. mein hain.
Humein find karna hai: \(k\).
Tareeqa: Reciprocals A.P. mein honge. Teen numbers \(x, y, z\) tab hi A.P. mein hote hain jab \(2y = x + z\). Yeh condition ek equation de degi.

Reciprocals lein
\[k, \quad 2k + 1, \quad 4k - 1 \text{ A.P. mein hain}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{k}\) ka ulta \(k\), \(\frac{1}{2k + 1}\) ka ulta \(2k + 1\), wagaira. H.P. ki definition yahi hai.

A.P. ki condition likhein
\[2(2k + 1) = k + (4k - 1)\]
Kyun: A.P. mein darmiyani term dono padosiyon ki average hoti hai: \(y = \frac{x + z}{2}\). Dono taraf 2 se multiply karein to \(2y = x + z\). Is tarah \(d\) alag se nikalne ki zaroorat nahi parti.
Dhyan dein: Yeh condition reciprocals par lagani hai, asal fractions \(\frac{1}{k}, \dots\) par nahi. Agar fractions par hi \(2y = x + z\) laga diya to equation bahut lambi aur ghalat ho jayegi.

Equation hal karein
\[4k + 2 = 5k - 1\]
\[2 + 1 = 5k - 4k\]
\[k = 3\]
Kyun: Bracket khola (\(2 \times 2k = 4k\), \(2 \times 1 = 2\)), right side par \(k + 4k = 5k\) kiya, phir \(k\) wali terms ek taraf aur numbers doosri taraf.

Tasdeeq
\[k = 3: \; 3, \; 7, \; 11\]
\[7 - 3 = 4, \quad 11 - 7 = 4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Farq barabar hai to yeh A.P. hai, aur \(\frac{1}{3}, \frac{1}{7}, \frac{1}{11}\) H.P. hai. Answer key mein 67 chhapa hai jo ghalat hai; neeche ki box dekhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key is sawal ka jawab "67" deti hai, jo ghalat hai. \(k = 67\) rakhein to reciprocals 67, 135, 267 bante hain; in ke farq 68 aur 132 hain jo barabar nahi, yani yeh A.P. nahi. Sahi jawab \(k = 3\) hai (H.P. \(\frac{1}{3}, \frac{1}{7}, \frac{1}{11}\)). Exam mein apna kaam aur tasdeeq dikhayein.
